tweet.text: At METR, we’ve seen increasingly sophisticated examples of “reward hacking” on our tasks: models trying to subvert or exploit the environment or scoring code to obtain a higher score. In a new post, we discuss this phenomenon and share some especially crafty instances we’ve seen.
